verdict.rationale: Swell documents serverless functions for custom logic on edge infrastructure with no cold starts, plus webhooks that subscribe to model events and call external services. Together these give an event-driven building block for background automation. However, the evidence never says functions run on schedules or event triggers, and nothing describes an AI-native or agent-driven automation feature. Missing for 10: scheduled/cron triggers, explicit event-triggered function execution, agent- or AI-driven autonomous workflows, independent corroboration.
